goals: Verify that the ui-fr-phone-number-mask directive correctly formats numeric inputs into French phone number format and ignores non-digit characters.
Verify that the ui-fr-phone-number-mask directive correctly integrates with ng-model by registering parsers and formatters and throwing an error if omitted.
activities: Attempt to compile an input element with 'ui-fr-phone-number-mask' but without 'ng-model'
Verify that the compilation throws an error
Compile an unmasked input element with 'ng-model' and retrieve its 'ngModel' controller
Compile a masked input element with 'ng-model' and 'ui-fr-phone-number-mask' and retrieve its 'ngModel' controller
Verify that the masked model has one additional $parser compared to the unmasked model
Verify that the masked model has one additional $formatter compared to the unmasked model
Compile an input element with 'ui-fr-phone-number-mask' and an initial model value of '3011201034'
Retrieve the 'ngModel' controller of the input
Verify that the model's $viewValue is formatted as '30 11 20 10 34'
Compile an input element with 'ui-fr-phone-number-mask' and 'allowInvalid:true'
Retrieve the 'ngModel' controller of the input
Iterate through a set of test cases containing non-digit characters
Set the input value to the test case value and trigger the 'input' event
Verify that the model's $viewValue matches the expected view value
Verify that the model's $modelValue matches the expected model value
